_avail.description: 4x2 Scaling Presentation Matrix Switchers for HDMI with DTP3 Extension

ports.label: HDMI Input 1
ports.notes: HDMI 2.0b / DVI 1.0, HDCP 2.3. Up to 4K @ 60Hz 4:4:4 (18 Gbps). De-embedded LPCM audio (2-Ch, up to 192kHz/24-bit) feeds the audio matrix; HD lossless / multi-channel formats pass through to HDMI outputs.

ports.label: USB-C Input (DP Alt Mode)
ports.notes: USB-C input with DisplayPort 1.2 Alt Mode (2 or 4 lanes; HBR/2.7 Gbps, HBR2/5.4 Gbps, HBR3/8.1 Gbps per lane; max 18 Gbps). Provides up to 60W USB-C Power Delivery to the connected source (charging only — no USB data on this base SKU; the USB-extension variant 60-1925-02 adds USB 3.2 host/device + DTP3 USB extension).

ports.label: HDMI Output 1A
ports.notes: HDMI 2.0 scaled output, with CEC. Output 1A and Output 1B (RJ-45) carry the same routed source simultaneously — both HDCP-compliant. +5V active-cable power up to 250mA.

ports.label: HDMI Output 2
ports.notes: HDMI 2.0 scaled output, with CEC. +5V active-cable power up to 250mA.

ports.label: Output 1B (DTP3 Scaled)
ports.notes: Configurable DTP3 / XTP / HDBaseT scaled buffered output. Carries HDMI + embedded audio + USB data + RS-232 + remote power up to 330ft (100m) on shielded CAT 6A. Mirrors HDMI Output 1A routing.; DTP3/XTP/HDBaseT

ports.label: Audio Output 1 (Stereo Line)
ports.notes: Variable balanced/unbalanced stereo analog line-level output on 3.5mm 5-pole captive screw. Configurable as 1 stereo or 2 mono channels. >+21 dBu max balanced, +15 dBu max unbalanced. 0 to -100 dB volume in 1 dB steps.

ports.label: LAN
ports.notes: 10/100/1000Base-T half/full-duplex Ethernet for switcher control + web UI + SIS protocol. 802.1X security. Default 192.168.254.254.

ports.label: RS-232 Pass-Thru
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 over the DTP3 link via Ethernet insertion. 3.5mm 3-pole captive (Pin 1=Tx, 2=Rx, 3=Gnd). 300-38400 baud.

ports.label: USB Configuration (Front)
ports.notes: Front-panel USB-C configuration port. IP over USB-C, USB 2.0 high speed.

ports.label: AC Mains
ports.notes: Internal universal-input PSU. 100-240 VAC, 50-60 Hz, IEC C14 inlet. 113.1W full / 76.6W power-save.
